metadata.description: Fictional complaint records across 3 retail stores covering all 7 official categories, designed to test spike detection, recurring issue detection, and priority scoring.

complaints.details: POS Terminal 2 is freezing again after 4 days of resolution. Smoke smell reported from adapter.
